metadata.desc: Use Koharu HTTP API to translate manga images from AstrBot chats.

koharu_api_base_url.hint: Koharu exposes HTTP API under /api/v1. Both http://host:port and http://host:port/api/v1 are accepted.

target_language.hint: Used as targetLanguage when the command does not provide a language.

pipeline_steps.hint: Comma-separated Koharu engine ids. Leave empty to read the selected pipeline engines from Koharu /config.

system_prompt.hint: Optional per-run systemPrompt passed to Koharu pipeline.

default_font.hint: Optional per-run defaultFont passed to Koharu pipeline.

auto_load_llm.hint: Enable this if Koharu does not already have a translation model loaded.

llm_kind.hint: provider uses providerId + modelId. local uses only modelId.

llm_provider_id.hint: Used only when llm_kind is provider.

llm_model_id.hint: Leave empty to skip auto loading. Must match a model shown by Koharu /llm/catalog.

max_send_images.hint: Use 0 to send all rendered images.

queue_depth.hint: Max number of requests waiting for translation. Concurrency is fixed at 1; requests exceeding the queue depth are rejected immediately. Use 0 to disallow queuing.

compress_return_images.hint: When enabled, translated results are transcoded before sending to reduce the chance of hitting chat platform file-size limits.

return_image_format.hint: Only used when return image compression is enabled. JPG does not support transparency and uses a white background.

return_image_quality.hint: Only used when return image compression is enabled. Range: 1-100. Lower values produce smaller files with lower quality.

delete_project_after_export.hint: After closing the project, call DELETE /projects/{id} to remove the project folder from Koharu.

result_retention_policy.hint: Controls cleanup for translated images under data/plugin_data/astrbot_plugin_koharu_plus/outputs/.

result_retention_days.hint: Only used when retention policy is Keep by days. Use 0 to delete on the next cleanup after sending.
